title: Cord and Creese
author: James De Mille
description: "Cord and Creese" by James De Mille is a novel likely written during the late 19th century.
longDescription: The narrative begins with the arrival of a letter from England to a man named Louis Brandon in Sydney, Australia, triggering a series of events tied to family tragedy, adventure, and intrigue.

authorInfo.bio: James De Mille (1833–1880) wrote A Strange Manuscript Found in a Copper Cylinder. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
